description: A React functional component implementing a key-value input UI element allowing users to dynamically add, edit, or remove key-value pairs, typically used for headers or similar structured data.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Adds an empty key-value pair to the list.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes the key-value pair at the specified index.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the key or value of the pair at the specified index.
